title: Customisable select
blurb: A <select> with appearance: base-select whose options are drawn by a canvas inside the picker: a wheel, a fisheye list, a radial menu, a 3D carousel, a hand of cards, a colour grid and a helix. Also a canvas in the button, a canvas inside each option, and a select drawn in a canvas.
question: Can a canvas inside a customisable <select> draw the options while the select keeps the value, the keyboard and hit testing? And does the picker of a select inside a canvas draw into that canvas?
result: Options inside a canvas inside the select work, in 2D, WebGL and WebGPU. The picker of a select that is in a canvas stays in the top layer and isn't drawn by that canvas.
